'''Port Landien''' was a [[Beach/Legends|beach]] [[City/Legends|town]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the location of the [[Port Landien Perfumery]]. A [[Sando aqua monster/Legends|sando aqua monster]] was found beached on one of its shores. [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], while still a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], apprehended a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] criminal at the Perfumery.<ref name="The Monster" />
